author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
**Verdict: Possible TAXSIM issue? (no PE change needed)**

PE already applies the rebate as a non-refundable credit, i.e. capped at line 20 per [MCA 15-30-2191(1)](https://web.archive.org/web/2024id_/https://leg.mt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0210/section_0910/0150-0300-0210-0910.html) ("the lesser of … line 20 … or … $1,250"). For the bundled row (pwages 9,030) PE and the current `taxsimtest` (20260521) both give `siitax = −1,041.45`; PE's netted rebate is 17.30 (the `srebate` column). The $1,250 only appears in our `v40` total, which sums the credit list before the cap — a display artifact we'll fix on our side.

Rerunning with pwages = 13,770 (as on the TaxAct return): PE line 20 = 89.68 → rebate 89.68 → `siitax −1,035.13`; `taxsimtest` gives −2,269.42, i.e. the full $1,250 with taxbc 15.70. Is `27mt.for` (`if(taxbc-crdnon.gt.0) rebate=rebatef(1250d0*d(7),…)`) meant to be a gate rather than a `min(1250, line 20)` cap?

Two side questions: (a) TAXSIM's MT AGI is 1,760.79 vs federal 9,034.85 — does the SS worksheet let `xl11 = xl9 − 25000` go negative (−14,539 → half added to AGI)? (b) The TaxAct return shows 13,770 wages, one exemption and no $800 interest exclusion — was age 70 entered?
